newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures end higher on speculative buying.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures end higher on speculative buying.

text.p: NYCE frozen concentrated orange juice finished firmer on a speculative-driven rally on the close, leading some in the market to forecast the beginning of an uptrend.
"We ran into spec buying in November which rallied the market," said Kevin Marshburn, an analyst with Fimat Futures. "This could be start of a small uptrend."
However, prices are not likely to make a substantial move ahead of the U.S. Department of Agriculture's next estimate for the Florida orange crop set to be released October 11, market sources said.
November closed at 108.10, up 2.50, having ranged from 108.50 to 106.00. The back months finished 2.00 to 1.60 higher.
